public_gates: fixed sampled and exact M270 objective improvement
six replay surfaces if row16 passes
old protected-key diagnostic if replay passes

forbidden_shortcuts: do not run PPO in M279

hypothesis: Adding the M278 current-hidden recovery anchor to the M270 objective and M275 retention anchor can improve objective while preserving row16 terminal-margin slack.
success_criteria: use M270 source-balanced objective, M275 retention trajectory anchor, and M278 recovery anchor
run exactly one small actor-coupling update before any repeat or PPO
improve fixed M270 objective versus M272
preserve M183/M170 row16 terminal margin above the registered required floor

failure_criteria: row16 terminal margin crosses the registered floor

commands.name: m279_actor_update
commands.command: Run one small actor-coupling update from m272b_a0_01025 using M270 objective, M275 retention anchor, and M278 recovery anchor, then gate row16 before broader proof gates.

decision_rule: M279 may promote only after objective improvement and row16, replay, protected-key, and behavior-retention gates pass. If row16 fails, classify the update as proof_washout/objective_overfit and do not run broader PPO.
